posts.copy: You have a cargo weight estimate. Does the hold volume support it? Review cargo weight, volume and stowage factor from your own figures in Astramate, with calculation steps visible before your next independent check.
Both draft marks matter when trim changes. Work through forward and aft draft, simple mean draft and trim in Astramate, then compare the figures with your vessel’s approved information.
Cargo weight alone does not tell you if a parcel fits the hold. Use Astramate’s stowage-factor, cargo-volume and cargo-weight tools to inspect the relationship between your entered figures.

That observed compass direction is not automatically a true bearing. Astramate helps you inspect compass-error working using your observed reading and externally verified true bearing or approved azimuth.
Before accepting a cargo estimate, check the arithmetic behind weight, volume and stowage factor. Astramate groups those inputs and visible calculation steps in a single maritime toolkit.
You have forward and aft draft readings, but need a clear trim check. Astramate brings supported simple mean-draft and trim calculations together for easier review of your own figures.

Stowage factor can change the cargo-weight estimate for a given hold volume. Enter your figures in Astramate, inspect the working and independently compare with approved shipboard loading information.

Compass deviation, variation and gyro error are not interchangeable. Astramate’s supported compass calculation tools show their working, helping you check the figures instead of trusting a bare answer.
Planning a bulk cargo parcel against available hold space? Review the cargo weight, stowage factor and volume with Astramate’s supported cargo and hold-utilization tools.
Reviewing vessel particulars and draft-related numbers? Keep the supported calculation steps in Astramate so you can inspect inputs clearly before any independent operational verification.
A hold can be full by volume before the estimated cargo weight reaches the target. Astramate’s cargo-volume and stowage-factor tools help you check that relationship using your own entered numbers.
Your compass conversion is only as useful as its source bearing. Put the observed and verified inputs into Astramate’s supported compass tools and inspect the calculation steps.
Forward draft, aft draft and mean draft are different values. Astramate lets you organize a simple draft-and-trim calculation instead of hunting through scattered notes.
Cargo figures may come in different units. When checking weight and volume, Astramate brings supported cargo calculations together with visible working so you can review the inputs.
